reason: The weighty bills set personal information against the access of the police, courts and publishers. Toward agreeing: excluding illegally obtained evidence (1, 37), minors' right to have data erased (2), erasing records (6, 15), therapy and professional privileges in trials (9, 10, 21, 28, 39), bans on publishing victims' names (20, 30), class actions for privacy (31). Away from agreeing: police computer hacking and special powers against crime organizations (14, 24), publishing the names of released security prisoners (3, 4), the Prison Service as a security authority (25), unmasking online harassers (29, 35). The trade-off 'protect personal data even if it is harder for the police and media to get it' fits these. The deepfake offence (7) and the student disability bill (36) are off-topic but light.
